# Knowledge Nodes

The fact record and who knows what: facts about an entity, an entity's current state, the timeline between two entities, an entry's Known by line, a character's knowledge report, entry visibility and grant/revoke knowledge edges.

## Character Knowledge

`knowledge/CharacterKnowledge`

What one character knows, as prompt text and without an LLM request:
their grants and revokes with entry labels, the restricted entries they
can see, the topic coverage and the awareness line.

**Inputs**

| Input | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `character` | `str,character` | character name or character |

**Outputs**

| Output | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `character` | `str` | the character name |
| `text` | `str` | the report |

## Current State

`knowledge/CurrentState`

The newest fact about an entity that no later fact supersedes.

**Inputs**

| Input | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `entity` | `str` | name of the entity |

**Outputs**

| Output | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `fact` | `knowledge/fact` | the fact dict, or None |
| `text` | `str` | the fact text, or an empty string |

## Entry Knowledge

`knowledge/EntryKnowledge`

Who knows a context entry: its Known by setting (or the presence of a
history entry) and the grant and revoke edges pointing at it.

**Inputs**

| Input | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `context_id_item` | `context_id_item` | the entry as a Context ID item |

**Outputs**

| Output | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `context_id_item` | `context_id_item` | the input, passed through |
| `entry_id` | `str` | the id knowledge edges use for the entry, or None |
| `text` | `str` | the Known by line, empty when the entry cannot be known or unknown |
| `visibility` | `dict` | the Known by setting as a dict, or None |
| `grants` | `list` | list of grant edge dicts |
| `revokes` | `list` | list of revoke edge dicts |

## Facts About

`knowledge/FactsAbout`

Facts recorded about an entity (character, item or place), oldest first.

**Inputs**

| Input | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `entity` | `str` | name of the entity |
| `character` | `str` | (optional) optional, only the facts this character knows |

**Outputs**

| Output | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `facts` | `list` | list of fact dicts |
| `text` | `str` | the facts as one line per fact |

## Grant Knowledge

`knowledge/GrantKnowledge`

Grant a character knowledge of an entry (a fact id, a sheet entry id,
a world entry id or a summarized history entry id).

**Inputs**

| Input | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `state` | `any` | graph state (passthrough) |
| `character` | `str,character` | character name or character |
| `target` | `str` | (optional) entry id (or give context_id_item) |
| `context_id_item` | `context_id_item` | (optional) the entry as a Context ID item (or give target) |
| `note` | `str` | (optional) optional note stored on the edge |

**Outputs**

| Output | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `state` | `any` | graph state |
| `edge` | `dict` | the stored edge |
| `text` | `str` | the entry's Known by line after the change |

**Properties**

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `note` | `str` | `""` | Optional note stored on the edge |
| `source` | `str` | `"granted"` | Where the edge comes from. Choices: `told`, `granted`, `inferred`, `manual`, `director`. |
| `replace` | `bool` | `False` | Keep one edge per character and entry: the new edge replaces an existing grant or revoke for the pair |

## Relationship Timeline

`knowledge/RelationshipTimeline`

Facts that mention both entities, oldest first.

**Inputs**

| Input | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `a` | `str` | first entity |
| `b` | `str` | second entity |

**Outputs**

| Output | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `facts` | `list` | list of fact dicts |
| `text` | `str` | one line per fact |

## Revoke Knowledge

`knowledge/RevokeKnowledge`

Revoke a character's knowledge of an entry.

**Inputs**

| Input | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `state` | `any` | graph state (passthrough) |
| `character` | `str,character` | character name or character |
| `target` | `str` | (optional) entry id (or give context_id_item) |
| `context_id_item` | `context_id_item` | (optional) the entry as a Context ID item (or give target) |
| `note` | `str` | (optional) optional note stored on the edge |

**Outputs**

| Output | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `state` | `any` | graph state |
| `edge` | `dict` | the stored edge |
| `text` | `str` | the entry's Known by line after the change |

**Properties**

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `note` | `str` | `""` | Optional note stored on the edge |
| `source` | `str` | `"granted"` | Where the edge comes from. Choices: `told`, `granted`, `inferred`, `manual`, `director`. |
| `replace` | `bool` | `False` | Keep one edge per character and entry: the new edge replaces an existing grant or revoke for the pair |

## Set Entry Visibility

`knowledge/SetEntryVisibility`

Set the Known by setting of a character sheet entry (description,
attribute, detail) or a world entry.

**Inputs**

| Input | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `state` | `any` | graph state (passthrough) |
| `context_id_item` | `context_id_item` | the entry as a Context ID item |
| `mode` | `str` | everyone, owner or list (required) |
| `characters` | `list` | (optional) the character names for the list mode |

**Outputs**

| Output | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `state` | `any` | graph state |
| `entry_id` | `str` | the id knowledge edges use for the entry |
| `text` | `str` | the entry's Known by line after the change |

**Properties**

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mode` | `str` | `"everyone"` | Who knows the entry. Choices: `everyone`, `owner`, `list`. |
